N_assessed.long_name: Number of students assessed in the immunization survey
N_assessed.short_description: Number of school students whose immunization records were assessed.
N_assessed.long_description: Count of students whose records were reviewed for this report. This is the survey denominator and is not necessarily the same as total enrolment, since not every enrolled student is always assessed.

rate_exempt_total.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
rate_exempt_total.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
rate_exempt_total.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, as reported in the Maine School Vaccination Rates workbooks.
rate_exempt_total.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

rate_exempt_medical.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_exempt_medical.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_exempt_medical.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_exempt_medical.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_exempt_religious.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious vaccination exemption
rate_exempt_religious.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_exempt_religious.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_exempt_religious.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

rate_exempt_philosophical.long_name: Proportion of students with a philosophical vaccination exemption
rate_exempt_philosophical.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a philosophical (personal-belief) exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_exempt_philosophical.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a philosophical or personal-belief exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_exempt_philosophical.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a philosophical vaccination exemption.

rate_90_day.long_name: Proportion of students in the 90-day provisional period
rate_90_day.short_description: Proportion of students within the 90-day grace period to submit immunization documentation.
rate_90_day.long_description: Share of students within the 90-day provisional period allowed to submit immunization documentation after enrolling.
rate_90_day.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were in the 90-day provisional period.

rate_missing.long_name: Proportion of students with no immunization record on file
rate_missing.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with no immunization documentation on file.
rate_missing.long_description: Share of assessed school students for whom no immunization record was on file at the time of the survey.
rate_missing.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had no immunization record on file.

rate_dtap.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination
rate_dtap.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination.
rate_dtap.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
rate_dtap.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for DTaP/Tdap vaccination.
